However, we must inform you that we have no record of a request for validation of the debt being made by you or anyone on your behalf. As per the FDCPA, we are required to provide validation of the debt upon request. We will not be providing validation at this time, as no such request has been made.

We will, however, investigate this matter further to determine the accuracy of the account information. We will also verify the licensing status of our agents in New Hampshire, as required by state law.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this debt further and request validation of the debt at any time. We will continue to work with you to resolve this matter.
